_doc: The identity SHM's IlkEntry (src/shm/mod.rs, #[repr(C)]) as its three copies read it: src/shm's tests, the Rust SDK's (crates/fluxbee_sdk/src/identity.rs) and the Go SDK's (identity_shm_test.go). Version 7 added works_for (the 16 bytes of the person's ILK, zeros for nobody) and work_role (one byte) before the 8 reserved bytes (docs/digital-executive-v1-stage-2.md §1.1). Change the layout here and in the three copies together.
